stack.method: GCC -fstack-usage plus reviewed acyclic own-call graph; 48/56-byte regular/joined assembly frames, 4-byte single-frame leaf, zero-local short-Hann helper; 4-byte call return PCs
stack.scope: Own frames of one callback activation, including outgoing arguments and entry return PC. Excludes stock/base frames, interrupt prologues, task stacks and interrupted callbacks. Not a whole-system stack reserve.
